title: Tail-Replay: Escaping the Curse of Linear Attention in Prefix Caching for Hybrid LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30310v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid large language models interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce the cost of long-context inference. This structure complicates prefix caching: full-attention key-value caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing hybrid prefix caching methods address this mismatch by storing recurrent-state checkpoints. As a result, token-level matches are directly usable only at positions aligned with stored checkpoints, constraining prefix reuse to a discrete set of boundaries. We present Tail-Replay, a prefix caching mechanism that enables unconstrained token-level prefix reuse in hybrid large language models. translated_title: Tail-Replay：摆脱混合大语言模型前缀缓存中线性注意力的魔咒
translated_abstract: 混合大语言模型通过将全注意力层与线性注意力层交错排列，以降低长上下文推理的成本。这种结构使前缀缓存变得复杂：全注意力的键值缓存可以按token寻址，而线性注意力层维护的循环状态无法回滚到任意的前缀边界。现有的混合前缀缓存方法通过存储循环状态检查点来解决这种不匹配问题。因此，token级别的匹配只能在与已存储检查点对齐的位置上直接使用，这将前缀重用限制在了一组离散的边界上。我们提出了Tail-Replay，这是一种能够在混合大语言模型中实现无约束token级前缀重用的前缀缓存机制。其关键洞察在于，诸如Gated DeltaNet之类的线性注意力机制可以被视为对输入前缀的结构化有损压缩：门控循环更新会逐步衰减……
tldr: 提出Tail-Replay前缀缓存机制，利用线性注意力可视为输入前缀结构化有损压缩这一洞察，使混合大语言模型摆脱循环状态检查点的限制，实现任意位置的token级前缀重用。
en_tdlr: Tail-Replay enables unconstrained token-level prefix reuse in hybrid LLMs by leveraging the insight that linear attention acts as a structured, lossy compression of the input prefix, escaping the checkpoint-bound limitations of existing hybrid prefix caching methods.
